decision.reason: 局部创建变快、分配减少，但原30秒配对未显示稳定端到端收益：Windows小场景P95三对均上升，Linux积压仍存在且方向混合。按未改变的接纳标准拒绝候选，精确恢复两处B18产品源文件并归档候选测试。局部构造或分配指标不能替代整体负载要求。
decision.decisionSource: Root reviewed actual original paired evidence and instructed rejected-and-restored; publication still requires completed local audit, exact rollback and a fresh nonincremental rebuild followed by actual focused tests.

priorFocusedReceipt.qualification: Earlier 29-pass run is preserved but not used to establish fresh restored-source binary identity; copied older source timestamps could leave outputs stale.

focused.qualification: Focused result after actual fresh rebuild, not a new full platform/performance qualification.

mechanism.qualification: Full conservative logical charges and historical capacity remain. No measured native/process memory saving is asserted.

measurementBoundaries.nativePlanConstruction: Retained native-plan creation belongs to chart.Render and therefore to the record interval when that call rebuilds its drawing. Original raw does not separately time plan creation or identify every scene-cache build; prepare alone is not a plan-construction measurement.
measurementBoundaries.record: new DrawingGroup + chart.Render + recursive Leaves primitive counting; neither a product-only allocation nor an isolated constructor timer.
measurementBoundaries.derivedAggregates: sourcePrepareRecordWorkMs and allocation sums are calculated within each request from disjoint original sourceApply/prepare/record intervals before percentile selection; recordAndRasterAllocatedBytes likewise sums original per-stage UI-thread observations. They are not sums of P95s or total process/native allocation.
measurementBoundaries.smallCohorts: smallMeasured, smallSourceReplacement and smallViewport use actual renderedCount<2048. Source replacement inherits the preceding viewport. Exact index/revision/range/count/point identities remain required for matched comparisons, including after differing warmup completion.

pairedIndependentAudit.scope: Independent original raw/JSONL binding, fixed slots/debt, original point identity, 84 actual archives and exact-state paired metrics. No summary-tool import, pooling, constructor attribution or performance acceptance.

localPlanCreation.qualification: Descriptive3-pair local creation+delegate/getter/checksum totals, current-UI-thread allocation only. Count2048 remains an unchanged-path control. No percentiles, record/raster/first-use/fixed-load/official/present/peak qualification.
